details: CVE-2026-78663 affects multiple packages. The HTTP/2 server can refund connection-level flow control twice for the same data: Once when a client resets a stream (refunding data for any sent-but-unread portion of the stream), and again when a request handler reads the buffered data. See references for individual vulnerability details.
